segments.description: Provides wastewater treatment, river water quality management and microbial products for pollutant cleansing in China through its operating subsidiary.
segments.evidence: Our main services and products include (1) wastewater treatment, (2) river water quality management, and (3) microbial products for water quality enhancement and pollutant cleansing purposes.

revenueModel.text: The company earns its revenue from providing wastewater treatment and river water quality management services and from selling microbial products for pollutant cleansing.
revenueModel.evidence: For the fiscal year ended October 31, 2025, our revenue primarily comes from (1) provision of wastewater treatment service, representing approximately 32.16% of our revenue; (2) provision of river water quality management service, representing approximately 51.12% of our revenue; and (3) sale of microbial products for pollutant cleansing, representing approximately 16.15% of our revenue.
